title: 8 不愿奋斗的妾不是好妾9 喜事从天降

8 不愿奋斗的妾不是好妾
如情笑得腼腆，“哥哥再怎么疼我，可几个嫂子才是真正当家作主的人。哪有官中锁事给妹子打理却让嫂子们闲着的道理？这完全是本末倒置了。”
挽雪心下惊异，胸口微跳，但却乖顺道：“可是，姑娘管家确实有一手。挽雪自叹拂不如。还是专心的侍候老爷，其他事儿，只能麻烦姑娘多担待点了。”
如情微笑道：“嫂子也太妄自菲薄了，前些日子京里来了信，家里已给哥哥选了门婚事，相信再过不久，新嫂子就要来大同了。兄嫂的事，我这个做妹子的，还是少掺和的好。所以，府里下人薪奉多少，嫂子看着办吧。不过，我先前对下人已诺言在先，还请嫂子看替我圆了这个承诺才好。”如情至始至终说话都笑眯眯的，仿佛对知义成亲的事儿，很是欢喜。再来对挽雪也很是友好，很是尊重的模样，并且言语间对即将上任的新嫂子也很是喜爱，挽雪听得袖子里的一双手，几乎把手帕给绞碎。
她摸不准如情刚才这番话，哪些是真，哪些是假，哪些只是拭探。这些日子以来，数度与她交手，从先前的明争转为暗斗，她都不是对手，首先在言语上她就占不了上风，私底下她也找不着地方使绊子。
如情看着随和，可管理下人却很有一套，不打不骂不罚，却让下人畏惧如虎。想挑唆下人使绊子的伎俩行不通后，她唯一的法子只能转战知义，可惜，知义却是个油盐不进的人，眼里心里只有这个妹子，压根儿没有她们的存在，她除了咬牙血吞外，也只能忍着受着了。本想着偃旗息鼓安份守已，可如今，自家老爷又要娶新夫人了，如情却当着她的面如此维护新妇，丝毫没有为她说话的意思，这让她情何以堪？
新夫人是好是坏她也不得而知，但见如情这么维护期待，挽雪咬牙，是该行最后一招了。
朝云听得她的计划，吓了一跳，连忙摆手：“妹妹，千万别做傻事，这招行不通呀。老爷什么性子你还不知道吗？一向是说一不二的，你这样做，岂不惹老爷生气？”朝云急得团团转，进一步劝道，“妹妹，我知道你心里不甘心，好好的大家闺秀如今沦落为看尽他人脸色的奴才，先前老太爷和老太君还承诺过咱们姐妹，若侍候尽心，会给咱们姐妹一个名份。妹妹，以咱们的身份，能抬为姨娘也是不错了。难不成，妹妹还想着被扶为正室不成？”
挽雪冷笑一声：“为什么不能？想我家道没中落之前，也是备受呵护的千金大小姐，如今，都成什么了？区区一个庶女都能把我踩在脚底下。我就是不服！同样都是官家小姐，为什么我只能看尽脸色，受尽贱踏，凭什么她就可以高高在上享尽一切？朝云，我不服，我就是不服。”
朝云看她半晌，幽幽道：“你不服又能怎样呢？情势比人强。你纵然不服，又能改变什么呢？”
挽雪坐在绣夏草虫的紫纱床沿上，绞着帕子良久，忽然坚定了神色：“当年张姨娘不也凭着这一招受尽万千宠爱么？我资色可不比她差。没道理她能成功，我就只能失败的。”
朝云更加叹息，“你想与张姨娘比？可是，老爷可不是老太爷呀。”
挽雪沉默了会，又道：“不会的，定能成功的。男人对于子嗣一向看重的。等那新妇一进门，我就借着肚子里的孩子与她一争高下。”
朝云摇头，“何苦呢？新夫人一旦进门，人家可是嫡妻，你拿什么跟人家斗？就凭肚子里的孩子么？我看难。”
“那可难说，当年，张姨娘不就是凭借着肚子里的孩子把小李夫人给挤兑得差点喝西北风么？”若不是老太太，估计小李氏早就被斗得尸骨无存了。
朝云见劝不动她，唯有无奈叹息，“张姨娘再如何的争强好胜，可还不是个妾。妹妹，听我的劝，别做傻事。就算你真的斗过了新夫人，可老爷也不会抚你为正妻的。你可知道，像方家这样的人家，哪有让一个下人当主母的。”
挽雪沉默了会，又咬牙道：“这也不行，那也不行，难不成，就真的一辈子都要忍气吞生？”见一脸气急败坏的朝云，她又继续找了理由，试图说服她，也试图说服自己，“没试过又怎能知道结果呢？放心，我不会打无把握的仗的。”
朝云叹气，“你连四姑娘都斗不过，还妄想斗过新夫人？我看你是异想天开了。”
挽雪面色挂不住，不禁冷笑一声：“谁说的，我不是斗不过她，只是不屑与她斗。若她胆敢挡我的路，我定要她好看。”
－－－－－－题外话－－－－－－

8 A concubine who is unwilling to fight is not a good concubine
Ruqing smiled shyly, "No matter how much my brother loves me, my sisters-in-law are the ones who are really in charge of the family. How can there be any reason why the official should lock things up for the sister but leave the sisters-in-law idle? This is completely putting the cart before the horse."
Wan Xue was surprised and her chest was beating slightly, but she said obediently: "But the girl's housekeeper does have a hand. Wan Xue feels inferior to Fu. She should concentrate on serving the master. For other things, I can only ask the girl to take more care of him."
Ruqing smiled and said: "Sister-in-law is too presumptuous. A letter came from Beijing a few days ago. The family has chosen a marriage for my brother. I believe that the new sister-in-law will come to Datong in the near future. As a sister, it is best for me to have less involvement in the matter of brother-in-law and sister-in-law. So, "It's up to my sister-in-law to decide how much the servants will be paid. However, I have made a promise to my servants before, so I would like to ask my sister-in-law to fulfill this promise for me." Ruqing smiled from beginning to end, as if she was very happy about Zhiyi's marriage. Furthermore, he was very friendly and respectful to Wan Xue, and expressed his fondness for the new sister-in-law who was about to take office. Wan Xue almost crushed the handkerchief when she heard the hands in her sleeves.
She wasn't sure which of Ruqing's words just now were true, which were false, and which were just tests. In the past few days, I have fought against her several times, and the previous open fights have turned into secret fights. She is no match. First of all, she can't get the upper hand verbally, and she can't find any way to get in the way in private.
Ruqing looks easy-going, but she has a very good way of managing her servants. She never hits, scolds or punishes her, but makes her servants fearful like a tiger. After her attempt to instigate her subordinates to trip up the girl didn't work, her only option was to fight Zhiyi. Unfortunately, Zhiyi was an insufferable person. He only had this girl in his eyes and heart, and they didn't exist at all. She could only endure it while gritting her teeth and swallowing blood. She originally wanted to give up her activities and live in peace, but now, her husband is marrying a new wife, but Ruqing defends his bride in front of her without any intention of speaking for her. How can she feel embarrassed?
She didn't know whether the new wife was good or bad, but seeing Ruqing maintaining her expectations so much, Wan Xue gritted her teeth. This was her last resort.
When Chao Yun heard her plan, he was shocked and waved his hands quickly: "Sister, don't do anything stupid, this won't work. Don't you know what my master's temper is? I always say what I say. If you do this, won't you make the master angry?" Chao Yun was anxious, and further persuaded, "Sister, I know you are not happy in your heart. Don't worry, our good ladies are now reduced to slaves who see other people's faces. Previously, the old lady and the old lady promised that if we serve our sisters diligently, sister, with our status, it is not bad to be promoted to the wife. "
Wan Xue sneered: "Why not? Before my family fell into decline, I was a well-protected rich lady. What has become of me now? A mere concubine can trample me under her feet. I just don't accept it! We are also a lady from an official family, why can I only see her face and suffer all the humiliation, why can she be so high and enjoy everything? Chaoyun, I don't accept it, I just don't accept it."
Chao Yun looked at her for a while and said quietly: "What can you do if you don't accept it? The situation is stronger than the person. Even if you don't accept it, what can you change?"
Wan Xue sat on the edge of the purple gauze bed embroidered with summer grass and insects, twisting the handkerchief for a long time, and suddenly her expression became firm: "Didn't Aunt Zhang get a lot of favors with this trick back then? My talents are no worse than hers. There is no reason why she can succeed, and I can only fail."
Chaoyun sighed even more, "You want to compete with Aunt Zhang? But I am not an old man."
Wan Xue was silent for a while, and then said: "No, it will definitely succeed. Men always value their heirs. As soon as the bride comes in, I will use my belly toThe children inside competed with her. "
Chao Yun shook his head, "Why bother? Once the new wife comes in, she is your legitimate wife, so what can you do to fight with her? Just because of the child in the belly? It's hard for me to see. "
"It's hard to say. Back then, didn't Aunt Zhang just rely on the child in her belly to squeeze Mrs. Li to the point where she almost drank the northwest wind? "If it weren't for the old lady, Xiao Li would have been beaten to pieces.
Seeing that he couldn't persuade her, Chao Yun could only sigh helplessly, "No matter how competitive Aunt Zhang is, she is still not a concubine. Sister, listen to my advice and don't do stupid things. Even if you really beat the new wife, the master will not make you his wife. Do you know that in a family like the Fang family, how could a servant be the mistress? "
Wan Xue was silent for a while, then gritted her teeth and said, "It won't work either this way or that way. Is it possible that I really have to endure my anger for the rest of my life? Seeing Chao Yun who looked furious, she continued to find reasons, trying to convince her and herself, "How can you know the result if you haven't tried it?" Don't worry, I won't fight an uncertain battle. "
Chao Yun sighed, "You can't even fight the fourth girl, but you still want to fight the new lady? I think you are out of your mind. "
Wan Xue looked helpless and couldn't help but sneered: "Who said that, it's not that I can't fight her, I just don't bother to fight with her. If she dares to block my way, I will make her look good. "
－－－－－－Digression－－－－－
